title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: About UsLabhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products — including Invoice Fly and Summary AI — are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first.We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter.Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.The RoleAt Labhouse, AI isn't just what we ship to users — it's how we operate internally. As our AI Engineer, you'll design and build LLM-powered tools, agents, and automations that remove friction and unlock speed across the company.This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will:Identify manual, repetitive, or slow processes and turn them into AI-powered tools and automationsDesign and build LLM-based agents that can reason, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks autonomouslyOwn projects end-to-end — from scoping the problem and understanding the business need, to designing, building, and shipping the solutionIntegrate LLMs and agents with internal systems and third-party toolsWork directly with team leads to understand where AI can unlock the most impact — and translate that into working productsMeasure the productivity and efficiency gains your work generates, and iterate based on real usageAbout YouAcademic BackgroundWe care more about what you've built than where you studied. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is a plus, but relevant hands-on experience matters more than the diploma.What We Are Looking ForYou've already done this before — you've walked into a company, spotted where AI could solve a real problem, and built the solution yourself, end to end. You're not looking for your first shot at this.Strong, proven experience working with LLMs in production — prompting, fine-tuning, RAG, or agent-based systemsDeep knowledge of agent frameworks and how to design multi-step, tool-using workflowsTrack record of shipping tools or automations that measurably improved productivity or performance in a companyStrong Python skills and comfort integrating APIs, webhooks, and third-party toolsBusiness vision — you understand how a company operates and can spot high-leverage opportunities for automation without being told where to lookComfortable working in fast-moving, data-heavy environments where speed and iteration matterExperience building tools or automations involving paid or organic acquisition data (campaigns, channels, attribution, or similar) is a strong plusAbility to work autonomously, prioritize based on impact, and ship without waiting for perfect conditionsAI ProficiencyYou live and breathe AI tools — not just LLM APIs, but the broader ecosystem of agents, copilots, and automation platforms. You stay on top of the state of the art and know how to turn new capabilities into practical, working tools fast.CommunicationYou communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You know how to interview a team about their pain points, translate that into a technical solution, and explain the result in terms they care about.Nice to HaveExperience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)Experience with automation/workflow platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make)Experience building tools involving data pipelines, dashboards, or reporting systemsPrior experience in a startup or fast-moving, resource-constrained environmentWhat We OfferCompetitive compensation packageHybrid work model based in Barcelona, with the option to work remotely from Spain for exceptional fits.High ownership from day one — you define the direction, not just execute on itWork directly with the founders and a senior, low-ego teamReal, immediate impact — your tools will be used by every team, every dayHiring ProcessInitial Interview: Meet with our Talent Acquisition Lead to discuss your background and fit for the role. We’ll also ask you to share your proudest projects.Hiring Manager Interview: A deep dive into your experience and leadership capabilities.Technical Assessment: Showcase your expertise through a practical task.Final Interview: A conversation with our leadership team to align on vision and expectations.Offer: Join our team and lead the development of our future-shaping apps!You should Know:Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of. title: Python developer with Gen AI/Agent (Python/GCP)
description: Description & RequirementsWho we are looking forWe are seeking for Python Developer with experience in building AI systems. This role requires deep expertise in Python, experience or exposure to leading agent orchestration frameworks (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, etc.), and extensive experience leveraging Google Cloud Platform’s Vertex AI suite. You will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing multi-step reasoning agents capable of advanced tool use, function calling, and managing diverse GenAI tasks across text and code generation domains. If you thrive on developing intelligent, goal-oriented AI applications, this is the role for you.Who We Are Looking ForYou are a pragmatic, solutions-focused developer with a robust background in software architecture and advanced AI concepts. You possess:Essential Python Proficiency: Exceptional expertise in Python is mandatory for ML development, API integration, and leveraging SDKs (Vertex AI SDK, OpenAI SDK). Agent Development Exposure: Experience in building and orchestrating complex AI workflows using state-of-the-art frameworks, specifically: LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK (Agent Development Kit). GenAI Task Experience: Practical experience developing solutions for core Generative AI tasks, including sophisticated function calling, code generation, classification, summarization, and prompt engineering for text generation. Grounding Techniques Knowledge: Understanding of grounding models using techniques like RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) to provide external, factual context for agents. GCP AI Ecosystem Familiarity: Strong working knowledge of key GCP GenAI and MLOps tools, including: Agent Tools: Direct experience utilizing Vertex AI Agent Builder for developing conversational and goal-oriented agents.Development Environments: A2A, Managed Compute Platform (MCP), Vertex AI Workbench/Notebooks for development.MLOps & Deployment: Vertex AI Pipelines for workflow orchestration.Model Management: Vertex AI Training for custom training, fine-tuning, and hyperparameter tuning.English proficiencyEU work permitNice-to-Have SkillsWhile not strictly required, candidates possessing the following skills will have a distinct advantage:Graph Databases: Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and their integration into LangGraph or RAG systems to manage complex relationships and contextual memory.Low-Latency Deployment: Experience optimizing GenAI applications for low-latency, high-throughput environments (e.g., using quantization or compiling models).Security & Compliance: Familiarity with data security principles related to PII/PHI handling within GenAI pipelines and implementing filtering mechanisms (e.g., DLP).Advanced MLOps: Deep experience with running production workloads on GKE or leveraging advanced features of Cloud Run for model serving.Your future roleAs a Generative AI Agent Developer, your primary responsibilities will include:Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy complex, multi-step AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK, ensuring efficient state management and execution paths. Tool and Function Calling: Implement robust mechanisms for agents to utilize external APIs, custom Python functions, and specialized tools (Tool Use) to achieve complex goals and interact with enterprise systems. GCP Service Integration: Leverage the full suite of Vertex AI services (Agent Builder, Pipelines, Workbench) to manage the entire agent lifecycle, from testing to scalable production deployment. Model Integration and Customization: Integrate and manage various foundational models (GCP, open source) and utilize Vertex AI Training for model customization where required. Infrastructure & Networking: Utilize general GCP infrastructure knowledge, including Compute (Agent Engine, GKE, Cloud Run) for deployment, and adhere to networking standards (VPC, Load Balancing, Cloud DNS). Performance and Reliability: Implement rigorous testing and logging to monitor agent behavior, optimize token usage, ensure reasoning accuracy, and minimize potential hallucinations. Documentation & Best Practices: Document agent architectures, development processes, and promote reusable design patterns across the engineering team. Show more Show less
